# Components

Each component's docs page, with code for one framework, is at `{docs}/components/{framework}/{slug}.md`. The framework
is `react`, `vue`, `svelte` or `solid`. Preact uses the React page.

| -------------------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
